name: Speedtest Tracker
summary: Your internet connection's latest download, upload and ping from Speedtest Tracker.
description: Reads the most recent result from Speedtest Tracker's API on your network (http://<address>/api/v1/results/latest) with an API token. Speedtest Tracker runs the tests on its own schedule; this app reports the last one and doesn't start a new test. Create the token in Speedtest Tracker under API Tokens with the "Read results" ability. Needs Speedtest Tracker 1.0 or later.
author: MeshHome

settings.label: Speedtest Tracker address
settings.help: The IP address or hostname of Speedtest Tracker on your network, with its port if it isn't 80. It is read over http://.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: In Speedtest Tracker: API Tokens → Create, with the "Read results" ability.

reply.empty: Speedtest Tracker's latest test has no result (it may have failed).
reply.unavailable: Speedtest Tracker isn't answering right now.
